scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['android/app/src/main/assets/public/downloads','android/app/src/main/assets/public/assets/aistudio'])fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon --max-workers=1 --stacktrace
scripts.android:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon --max-workers=1 --stacktrace
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease --no-daemon --max-workers=1 --stacktrace
